observations: Three photos show a metal automotive wiper mechanism with a motor attached, lying on a cracked concrete floor.
The mechanism has a long arm with multiple pivot points and a motor housing with a cylindrical component and cooling fins.
The metal is gray and shows signs of wear, rust, and dirt, especially on the motor and joints.
No visible branding, model numbers, or part numbers are readable on the item in any photo.
The seller claims it is an 'Engine wiper Audi Q7 2008/2013', but no such text appears on the item itself.
The photos are watermarked 'POSTED ON JIJI CHIBEX'.

claims.evidence: No brand or model markings are visible on the item in any photo. The claim is based solely on the seller's text.
